Definition: from G3326 and G2059; to explain over, i.e. translate:--(by) interpret(-ation).
BiblicalUsage: The apostles explain that Barnabas means the son of consolation, and the disciples explain that Rabbi means Master. The word is the work of translation itself, and the New Testament pauses to translate names so the reader knows what they mean.
TheologicalSignificance: I notice that Scripture never leaves a name unexplained when its meaning matters: Barnabas is the son of consolation because his life consoled, and Rabbi is Master because Jesus is one.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
